question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The doctor who deals with the female reproductive system.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gynecologist"** means a medical doctor who specializes in the health of the female reproductive system. (स्त्री रोग विशेषज्ञ)

 
 
• **Example: **She visited a** gynecologist **for her routine check-up.
 
 
 
• **"Gynecologist" **is derived from the Greek words "gynē" meaning "woman" and "logia" meaning "study." (स्त्री और अध्ययन)
 
 
• **Example: **The **gynaecologist** provided excellent care during her pregnancy.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the doctor who deals with the female reproductive system is called a **'Gynecologist'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ophthalmologist **(नेत्र रोग विशेषज्ञ): A medical doctor specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of eye disorders.

 
 
• **Example:** He consulted an **ophthalmologist **for his vision problems.
 
 
 
• **Orthodontist **(दंत चिकित्सक): A dental specialist who corrects irregularities in the teeth and jaws.
 
 
• **Example: **She visited an** orthodontist **to get braces.
 
 
 
• **Cardiologist** (हृदय रोग विशेषज्ञ): A medical doctor specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of heart diseases.
 
 
• **Example:** The **cardiologist **advised him to change his diet to improve heart health.
 
 

 

3a:Td49,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
